How to accept/reject breakdown jobs assigned by Dispatch.

STEP 1: Open your Technician Dashboard and tap Active Breakdowns.
STEP 2: Review assigned breakdown description, truck registration and location.
STEP 3: Tap Accept Job (which sets your status to En Route) or Reject Job (providing a reason for Dispatch re-allocation).
STEP 4: Tap Map Nav to launch turn-by-turn navigation to the breakdown site.
Mandatory area safety check before beginning repair work.

STEP 1: Upon arrival at the breakdown, tap Safety Inspection.
STEP 2: Assess roadside traffic, warning triangle placement and ground stability.
STEP 3: Check PPE (vest and boots) and vehicle wheel chocks/isolation.
STEP 4: If safe, submit to proceed. If UNSAFE, toggle Unsafe to trigger immediate Safety Escalation to Dispatch.
Diagnose faults, estimate labour & parts, and submit quotation for Admin approval.

STEP 1: Tap Assessment & Quote on the job card.
STEP 2: Fill in truck details (Make/Model, VIN, Odometer, Engine specifications).
STEP 3: Record identified fault, cause and diagnostic results.
STEP 4: Enter estimated labour hours, parts cost and travel expenses.
STEP 5: Tap Calculate Total Quote and Submit Assessment & Quotation. Wait for Admin approval notification before starting work.
Publish milestone updates and updated repair ETAs.

STEP 1: Tap Progress Log on the active job card.
STEP 2: Select progress milestone (e.g. Pneumatic Air Lines Flushed, Brake Chambers Replaced).
STEP 3: Enter progress description and revised completion ETA.
STEP 4: Tap Publish Progress Update to notify Dispatch and Customer.
Record parts used and request authorization for extra costs.

STEP 1: Tap Parts & Approval.\nSTEP 2: Enter part name, OEM part number and quantity used on job card.\nSTEP 3: If additional out-of-scope work is discovered, fill out the Additional Work Request form and submit to Admin for approval.
Flag unsuccessful repairs or complaints for return visits.

STEP 1: If a repair cannot be completed or is unsuccessful, tap Flag Return.\nSTEP 2: Select flag reason (Repair Unsuccessful, Specialist Required, Parts Unavailable, etc.).\nSTEP 3: Provide detailed explanatory notes and submit to Dispatch.
How to log a breakdown request and attach breakdown location.

STEP 1: Open Customer Dashboard and tap Request Roadside Assistance.
STEP 2: Enter truck registration number and describe the breakdown problem.
STEP 3: Tap Take Photo of Problem to capture evidence.
STEP 4: Tap Attach My Pin Location to use GPS or pick location on map.
STEP 5: Tap Submit Assistance Request.
Track allocated technician arrival and approve repair quotes.

STEP 1: Open Customer Dashboard and tap My Requests History.\nSTEP 2: View assigned technician name, contact, status and live arrival ETA.\nSTEP 3: When a quotation is submitted by the technician, tap your request to review and approve the quote.
How to trigger an immediate emergency alert.
Tap the SOS button located at the top right of any screen. Confirm the alert to notify Dispatch and nearby technicians immediately.
Using AI for technical truck troubleshooting.
Tap AI Assistant on the Technician Dashboard. Ask questions about pneumatic air brake pressure loss, Cummins/Volvo SPN fault codes, or WABCO ABS testing.
Working in remote areas without mobile coverage.
All safety inspections, job cards, assessments and progress updates are saved locally in SQLite when offline. Records automatically sync to Dispatch once connectivity returns.
How to diagnose Air Brake Pressure Loss on a heavy truck?
What is SPN 651 FMI 5 Injector Cylinder 1 fault and how to repair?
How to test Wabco ABS Modulator Valves and Wheel Speed Sensors?

AIR BRAKE DIAGNOSTIC PROCEDURE:
1. Check Air Compressor output pressure & Governor cut-out settings (standard cut-out 120-135 PSI).
2. Perform leak test: Chock wheels, release spring brake, pump system to 100 PSI, observe gauge for 1 minute (max 2 PSI drop for straight truck, 3 PSI for combination).
3. Inspect Air Dryer purge valve & Four-Circuit Protection Valve for blockages or diaphragm rupture.
4. Check Foot Brake Valve (Dual Brake Valve) & Relay Valve exhaust ports for continuous leakage.

DIESEL ENGINE FAULT CODE DIAGNOSIS (SPN 651 / INJECTOR CIRCUIT):
1. SPN 651 FMI 5 indicates Open Circuit / High Resistance on Injector #1 Solenoid.
2. Check valve cover pass-through harness connector for oil contamination or loose pins.
3. Measure Injector Solenoid Resistance: Expected range is 0.2 to 1.5 Ohms. Resistance above 2.0 Ohms indicates failed injector coil.
4. Check ECM harness continuity between ECM Pin 15 & Injector Pin A.

WABCO ABS MODULATOR & SENSOR DIAGNOSTIC:
1. Check Wheel Speed Sensor Air Gap: Push sensor in until it touches tone wheel; wheel rotation self-adjusts gap.
2. Resistance test: WABCO passive sensor resistance must be 900 - 2000 Ohms.
3. Test Modulator Valve Solenoids: Resistance across Inlet/Outlet pins should be 12-18 Ohms.
4. Verify 24V supply to ABS ECU.

ROADSIDE SAFETY DIRECTIVE:
1. Park vehicle on stable shoulder. Turn on hazard lights.
2. Place Warning Triangles at 45m, 90m, and 150m behind breakdown.
3. High-visibility reflective vest and safety boots are MANDATORY.
4. Chock truck drive wheels before going beneath vehicle.

GENERAL TRUCK TECHNICAL ASSISTANCE:
For query: %1$s
1. Inspect primary mechanical/electrical connections.
2. Perform digital OBD scan using heavy-duty diagnostic scanner.
3. Refer to OEM Service Manual & PE Airbrakes Safety Regulations.
4. If hazard exists, submit Safety Escalation to Dispatch Admin immediately.
